{{Otheruses|Virus}}
A '''computer virus''' was a harmful "infection" of a computer system. It was caused by a third-party hack of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]] or other type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system.

One such virus was [[Black Envy]], developed by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:WtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Warning the Allies|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
